data.name: Jerwan
data.gender_notes: Jerwan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is gentle and kind, derived from the Arabic word 'ruran' meaning gentle or kind. The name Jerwan carries the meaning “Gentle, Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Jerwan usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a gentle and kind soul, who is loved and respected by all.
data.etymology: Jerwan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jerwan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: جروان
in_arabic.meaning: جروان تعني الفتى الشاب القوي وال勇
in_arabic.long_meaning: جروان هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، ويعني الفتى الشاب القوي وال勇، وقد ورد في بعض الروايات أنه مشتق من جروان وهو الاسم الذي يطلق على الذئب الصغير، وقد ذكر بعض المفسرين أنه من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القوة والشجاعة، وقد استخدم في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية كاسم للذكور.

in_urdu.name: جروان
in_urdu.meaning: جروان مطلب ہے مضبوط اور بہادر نوجوان
in_urdu.long_meaning: جروان ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے مضبوط اور بہادر نوجوان، یہ نام عربی زبان کے جروان سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے ذئب کا بچہ، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں مضبوطی اور بہادری کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلم کمیونٹی میں۔

in_hindi.name: जरवान
in_hindi.meaning: जरवान का अर्थ है मजबूत और बहादुर युवक
in_hindi.long_meaning: जरवान एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है मजबूत और बहादुर युवक, यह नाम अरबी भाषा के जरवान से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है भेड़िये का बच्चा, यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में मजबूती और बहादरी के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है, खासकर भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में।

in_pashto.name: جروان
in_pashto.meaning: جروان د قوي او زړور ځوان معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: جروان د عربي نوم دی چې د قوي او زړور ځوان معنی لري، دا نوم د عربي ژبې د جروان څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې د ذئب د ماشوم معنی لري، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دودیزو کړو کې د زړورتیا او قوت د نښه په توګه کارول کیږي.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jerwan is derived from the Arabic word 'ruran,' meaning gentle or kind. In Islamic culture, the name is given to children as a reminder of the prophetic character of displaying kindness and compassion towards others. This name signifies a strong emphasis on the values of empathy, compassion, gentleness, and respect for others, which are essential for building a peaceful community and are deeply ingrained in Islamic teachings.

It serves as a daily reminder for the bearer of the name to strive towards developing good manners, compassion, and kindness, which ultimately will lead to a better and fulfilling life, both in this world and in the hereafter.

historical_references.reference: The name Jerwan is believed to be derived from the Arabic word 'Jarwan', which means 'the place of the well'. This name was used during the early Islamic period, particularly during the Umayyad Caliphate (661-750 AD), when the city was an important stopover on the trade route between Damascus and the Persian Gulf.

Another theory suggests that Jerwan is named after Dhu Al-Jarwaan, a famous tribal leader from the Banu Rabi'ah tribe who was a prominent figure during the early Islamic period. He is said to have led his tribe to settle in the area around Jerwan and established a caravan station there. The name of the city may have been derived from his tribal name 'Jarwaan'.

historical_references.context: Both these references indicate that the name Jerwan is rooted in the Islamic history and has significance during the early Islamic period.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Jerwan' is derived from a Persian word meaning 'rose water'. It is a popular name for a traditional Persian dessert made with rose water, rice, and sugar. Jerwan is a popular dessert in Iranian cuisine and is loved for its sweet and fragrant taste. In modern times, Jerwan has gained popularity on various digital platforms. On Instagram, food bloggers share beautiful images of this delicious dessert, using hashtags such as #Jerwan or #PersianDesserts. On Pinterest, users can find various recipes and ideas for making Jerwan at home. On YouTube, cooking channels offer step-by-step instructions on how to prepare this dessert. The trend of sharing and discovering traditional recipes online has helped to introduce Jerwan to a wider audience, making it a modern favorite in the world of Persian cuisine and food blogging.
